globalpw.description: Prompt a global password for all connections (-g)

script_file.description: Read commands from a script file (-s), disables default COMMAND

hostsfile.description: Read the list of hosts from a file (-r), disables default HOSTS

args.description: Arguments to be passed to the script file (-a)

quiet.description: Disable all screen output, except for password prompts (-q)

shell.description: Remote shell to be used. Supported values: sh, bash.

logfile.description: Append SSH output to a file (--logfile)

command.description: Command to execute on remote hosts (disabled if script_file is set)

hosts.description: List of target hosts (disabled if hostsfile is set). Each item is a string hostname or IP.
